statements: PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS runtime_identity (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  node_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  node_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  cluster_id TEXT,
  node_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (node_role IN ('standalone','leader','worker')),
  authority_public_key BLOB NOT NULL,
  authority_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS devices (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  platform TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('ios','ipados','macos')),
  public_key_spki BLOB NOT NULL,
  public_key_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  presence_public_key_spki BLOB,
  presence_public_key_fingerprint TEXT,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('owner','administrator','developer','user','observer')),
  capability_overrides_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  paired_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at TEXT,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS devices_role_idx ON devices(role, revoked_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pairing_invitations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  role TEXT NOT NULL,
  nonce_hash BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  issued_by_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_name_hint TEXT,
  issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT,
  consumed_by_device_id TEXT,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  signed_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (issued_by_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (consumed_by_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pairing_invites_expiry_idx
  ON pairing_invitations(expires_at, consumed_at, revoked_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pairing_challenges (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  invitation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  challenge_hash BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  device_public_key_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (invitation_id) REFERENCES pairing_invitations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS request_nonces (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  nonce_hash BLOB NOT NULL,
  seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (device_id, nonce_hash),
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS request_nonces_expiry_idx ON request_nonces(expires_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_records (
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  method TEXT NOT NULL,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  status_code INTEGER NOT NULL,
  response_json TEXT,
  operation_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (device_id, method, path, idempotency_key),
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_expiry_idx ON idempotency_records(expires_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS provider_credentials (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  provider TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  secret_reference TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_by_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_used_at TEXT,
  revoked_at TEXT,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY (created_by_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pairing_challenges_expiry_idx ON pairing_challenges(expires_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_records_expiry_idx ON idempotency_records(expires_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS models (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  recipe_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
  recipe_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  install_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    install_state IN ('available','downloading','verifying','installed','failed','incompatible','unverified')
  ),
  installed_at TEXT,
  manifest_path TEXT,
  total_bytes INTEGER,
  measured_peak_bytes INTEGER,
  last_used_at TEXT,
  failure_code TEXT,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_files (
  model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  download_state TEXT NOT NULL,
  completed_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  etag TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (model_id, relative_path),
  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS model_profiles (
  model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  context_length INTEGER NOT NULL,
  max_sequences INTEGER NOT NULL,
  max_batched_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,
  gpu_memory_utilisation REAL NOT NULL,
  expected_peak_bytes INTEGER,
  measured_peak_bytes INTEGER,
  safe INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  last_failure_code TEXT,
  last_measured_at TEXT,
  measured_environment TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (model_id, profile_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inference_instances (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  cluster_id TEXT,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    state IN ('loading','ready','idle','draining','unloading','failed','stopped')
  ),
  container_id TEXT,
  internal_port INTEGER,
  internal_secret_reference TEXT,
  started_at TEXT,
  ready_at TEXT,
  stopped_at TEXT,
  failure_code TEXT,
  peak_memory_bytes INTEGER,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY (model_id, profile_id) REFERENCES model_profiles(model_id, profile_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS operations (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    state IN ('requested','validating','queued','running','waiting_for_approval','cancelling','cancelled','succeeded','failed')
  ),
  actor_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource_id TEXT,
  progress REAL CHECK (progress IS NULL OR (progress >= 0 AND progress <= 1)),
  stage TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at TEXT,
  completed_at TEXT,
  error_code TEXT,
  result_json TEXT,
  cancellable INTEGER NOT NULL,
  lease_owner TEXT,
  lease_expires_at TEXT,
  input_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY (actor_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS operations_state_idx ON operations(state, updated_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS operations_actor_idx ON operations(actor_device_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS operations_resource_idx ON operations(resource_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS operation_stages (
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  stage TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  progress REAL,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  completed_at TEXT,
  details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  PRIMARY KEY (operation_id, sequence),
  FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
  sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  severity TEXT NOT NULL,
  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  cluster_id TEXT,
  operation_id TEXT,
  resource_id TEXT,
  visibility_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_type_idx ON events(event_type, sequence);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_operation_idx ON events(operation_id, sequence);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_time_idx ON events(occurred_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage_daily (
  day TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cached_prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  generated_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  reasoning_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  requests INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cumulative_ttft_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cumulative_generation_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (day, device_id, model_id, project_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_records (
  sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor_device_id TEXT,
  actor_role TEXT,
  source_route TEXT,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource TEXT,
  result TEXT NOT NULL,
  operation_id TEXT,
  request_id TEXT,
  details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  previous_hash BLOB,
  record_hash BLOB NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_actor_idx ON audit_records(actor_device_id, sequence);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_action_idx ON audit_records(action, sequence);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS remote_access (
  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
  enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('disabled','private_overlay')),
  hostname TEXT,
  health TEXT NOT NULL,
  enabled_at TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_members (
  cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('leader','worker')),
  authority_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  endpoint TEXT,
  reachable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  qsfp_interface TEXT,
  qsfp_health TEXT,
  runtime_version TEXT,
  last_seen_at TEXT,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  PRIMARY KEY (cluster_id, node_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_transactions (
  transaction_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  proposal_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(proposal_digest) = 64),
  coordinator_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  local_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  peer_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('preparing','prepared','active','proved','collective','committing','committed','ready','rolling_back','rolled_back','failed')),
  proposal_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  grant_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  proof_json TEXT,
  fabric_auth_json TEXT,
  collective_json TEXT,
  commit_receipt_json TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(owner_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_link_proofs (
  cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  member_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  peer_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  proposal_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(proposal_digest) = 64),
  local_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  peer_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  interface TEXT NOT NULL,
  local_mac TEXT NOT NULL,
  neighbour_mac TEXT NOT NULL,
  speed_mbps INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(speed_mbps >= 200000),
  mtu INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(mtu = 9000),
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  authority_signature TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(cluster_id, member_node_id, peer_node_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_collective_proofs (
  cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  member_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  proposal_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(proposal_digest) = 64),
  node_rank INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(node_rank IN (0, 1)),
  fabric_auth_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  authority_signature TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(cluster_id, member_node_id),
  UNIQUE(cluster_id, node_rank)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_device_grants (
  cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  member_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('owner','administrator')),
  device_key_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(device_key_fingerprint) = 64),
  proposal_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(proposal_digest) = 64),
  authority_signature TEXT NOT NULL,
  issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(cluster_id, member_node_id, device_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_commit_receipts (
  cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  member_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  proposal_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(proposal_digest) = 64),
  committed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  authority_signature TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(cluster_id, member_node_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cluster_launches (
  launch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  cluster_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  operation_id TEXT,
  recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  profile_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  execution_spec_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('preparing','running','degraded','stopping','stopped','failed')),
  coordinator_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  worker_node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  failure_code TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(operation_id) REFERENCES operations(id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS cluster_transactions_state_idx
  ON cluster_transactions(state, updated_at);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS cluster_launches_cluster_state_idx
  ON cluster_launches(cluster_id, state);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('creating','ready','stopped','failed','deleting')),
  repository_url TEXT,
  default_branch TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  policy_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_members (
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  permission TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (permission IN ('read','write','approve','admin')),
  granted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (project_id, device_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_worktrees (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  operation_id TEXT,
  path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  base_commit TEXT NOT NULL,
  branch_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('creating','active','review','merged','rejected','failed','deleted')),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES operations(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  requested_by_device_id TEXT,
  requested_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','expired','cancelled')),
  decided_by_device_id TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  decision_comment TEXT,
  expires_at TEXT,
  evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (decided_by_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS build_workers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  platform_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  xcode_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('online','busy','offline','revoked')),
  registered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at TEXT,
  heartbeat_expires_at TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS builds (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  worker_id TEXT,
  commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
  scheme TEXT NOT NULL,
  configuration TEXT NOT NULL,
  destination TEXT NOT NULL,
  actions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  timeout_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL
    CHECK (status IN ('queued','claimed','running','completed','failed','cancelled')),
  result_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  requested_by_device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  claim_token_hash BLOB,
  claim_expires_at TEXT,
  source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  requirements_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  claim_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  claim_request_id TEXT,
  recipe_json TEXT,
  recipe_sha256 TEXT,
  artifact_token_hash BLOB,
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES operations(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES build_workers(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_device_id) REFERENCES devices(id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS build_artifacts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  worker_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  build_id TEXT,
  claim_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (project_id) REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES build_workers(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (build_id) REFERENCES builds(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS builds_status_idx ON builds(status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS builds_project_idx ON builds(project_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS builds_worker_lease_idx
  ON builds(worker_id, status, claim_expires_at);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS build_artifacts_build_id_idx
  ON build_artifacts(build_id, claim_generation, id);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS devices_owner_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF role, revoked_at ON devices
WHEN OLD.role = 'owner'
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM devices
      WHERE role = 'owner'
        AND revoked_at IS NULL
        AND id <> OLD.id
    ) = 0
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'cannot remove last active owner')
  END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS devices_owner_delete_guard
BEFORE DELETE ON devices
WHEN OLD.role = 'owner' AND OLD.revoked_at IS NULL
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM devices
      WHERE role = 'owner'
        AND revoked_at IS NULL
        AND id <> OLD.id
    ) = 0
    THEN RAISE(ABORT, 'cannot remove last active owner')
  END;
END;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_samples (
  bucket_start INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  cpu_utilisation REAL,
  load_average_1m REAL,
  memory_total_bytes INTEGER,
  memory_available_bytes INTEGER,
  memory_pressure TEXT
    CHECK (memory_pressure IS NULL
           OR memory_pressure IN ('normal', 'warning', 'critical', 'emergency')),
  temperature_celsius REAL,
  accelerator_utilisation REAL,
  accelerator_memory_used_bytes INTEGER,
  accelerator_memory_total_bytes INTEGER,
  active_requests INTEGER,
  queue_depth INTEGER,
  tokens_per_second REAL,
  time_to_first_token_ms REAL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_samples_observed_idx
  ON telemetry_samples(bucket_start DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_minutes (
  bucket_start INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  sample_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  cpu_utilisation_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cpu_utilisation_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  load_average_1m_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  load_average_1m_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  memory_available_bytes_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  memory_available_bytes_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  temperature_celsius_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  temperature_celsius_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  accelerator_utilisation_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  accelerator_utilisation_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  accelerator_memory_used_bytes_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  accelerator_memory_used_bytes_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active_requests_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active_requests_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  queue_depth_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  queue_depth_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tokens_per_second_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tokens_per_second_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  time_to_first_token_ms_sum REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  time_to_first_token_ms_n INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  memory_total_bytes_max INTEGER,
  accelerator_memory_total_bytes_max INTEGER,
  memory_pressure_rank INTEGER
    CHECK (memory_pressure_rank IS NULL OR memory_pressure_rank BETWEEN 0 AND 3)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_minutes_observed_idx
  ON telemetry_minutes(bucket_start DESC);

CREATE TABLE household_notes (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
    author_device_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id),
    author_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_by_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    deleted_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX household_notes_updated ON household_notes(updated_at, id);
